params.name: side
params.reference:
On entry, `SIDE` specifies whether the symmetric matrix A appears on the left or right in the operation as follows:

$$
\mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'L'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'l'} C := \alpha \, A \, B + \beta \, C
$$

$$
\mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'R'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'r'} C := \alpha \, B \, A + \beta \, C
$$

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
On entry, `UPLO` specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is to be referenced as follows:

`UPLO = 'U'` or 'u' Only the upper triangular part of the

symmetric matrix is to be referenced.

`UPLO = 'L'` or 'l' Only the lower triangular part of the

symmetric matrix is to be referenced.

params.name: M
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of the matrix C. M must be at least zero.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of the matrix C. N must be at least zero.

params.name: A
params.reference: m when `SIDE = 'L'` or 'l' and is n otherwise. Before entry with `SIDE = 'L'` or 'l', the m by m part of the array A must contain the symmetric matrix, such that when `UPLO = 'U'` or 'u', the leading m by m upper triangular part of the array A must contain the upper triangular part of the symmetric matrix and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced, and when `UPLO = 'L'` or 'l', the leading m by m lower triangular part of the array A must contain the lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced. Before entry with `SIDE = 'R'` or 'r', the n by n part of the array A must contain the symmetric matrix, such that when `UPLO = 'U'` or 'u', the leading n by n upper triangular part of the array A must contain the upper triangular part of the symmetric matrix and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced, and when `UPLO = 'L'` or 'l', the leading n by n lower triangular part of the array A must contain the lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced.

params.name: lda
params.reference: On entry, `LDA` specifies the first dimension of A as declared in the calling (sub) program. When `SIDE = 'L'` or 'l' then `LDA` must be at least max( 1, m ), otherwise `LDA` must be at least max( 1, n ).

params.name: B
params.reference: Before entry, the leading m by n part of the array B must contain the matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: On entry, `LDB` specifies the first dimension of B as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDB` must be at least max( 1, m ).

params.name: beta
params.reference: On entry, `BETA` specifies the scalar $\beta$. When `BETA` is supplied as zero then C need not be set on input.

params.name: C
params.reference: Before entry, the leading m by n part of the array C must contain the matrix C, except when $\beta$ is zero, in which case C need not be set on entry. On exit, the array C is overwritten by the m by n updated matrix.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: On entry, `LDC` specifies the first dimension of C as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDC` must be at least max( 1, m ).
